summary: Bind native requests to immutable policy, isolated audit profiles and owned worker lifetime (S7)

delivery.outcome: Explicit immutable resolved-policy and per-request audit/deadline/cancel scopes, with native worker policy digest checks and Linux parent-death/group cleanup.
nonGoals: No resolver.py edits, provider execution bypass, arbitrary code executor, new dependency, PyPI publication or global catalog-profile migration.
Linux parent-death protection is explicit; unsupported platforms fail closed when that capability is required.

architecture.decision: Reuse policy parser/route validation and native audit writers. Catalog overlays become copy-on-write ContextVars. A request scope pins parsed policy/catalog and checks raw source digest before dispatch; workers independently compare the selected policy digest. An owned pipe runner polls the shared absolute deadline/cancellation, keeps group leader unreaped through cleanup and installs Linux parent-death protection.
architecture.rollback: Revert additive request scopes and worker lifetime adapters while preserving native policy validation and persistence contracts.

commands: Policy mutation between resolution and dispatch; worker startup digest mismatch
validation.evidence: No request reaches an unaccepted route and no success is attributed to another policy.

commands: Concurrent thread/process profiles, nested audit and stream contexts
validation.evidence: Distinct providers, archives and journals without global environment mutation.

commands: SIGTERM/SIGKILL parent during slow HTTP, normal leader exit with live descendant, absolute cancellation/deadline
validation.evidence: Owned worker/descendants stop and cancelled/expired calls never succeed.

commands: Affected regression; Ruff/docs/logs/governance; protected full CI and exact-head independent merge
